text: Why does IPv6 have no broadcast address?
choices: The designers concluded broadcast was a mistake and replaced it with scoped multicast groups
Broadcast is handled by the router
explanation: Every host must process every broadcast, interrupting its CPU regardless of relevance. IPv6 uses well-known multicast groups such as ff02::1 (all nodes) and ff02::2 (all routers) so that only interested hosts are disturbed.
